source_invariants: M414 admits row IDs once and in ascending order within a phase; M467 writes at most one descriptor for each active row.
The execution scheduler visits each admitted descriptor exactly once at every slot in logical order 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7, although other descriptors may interleave between tile0 and tile1.
A row-live bit is set only on the accepted slot7 accumulator write, after that row has initialized all earlier slots.
The operator commit scan visits slots 0 through 7, with every row inside each slot. A row-live bit is cleared only on its accepted slot7 commit.
Ordinary phase release never clears row-live or forwarding state; operator-final commit does.
forbidden_mutations: Set row-live at slot0 or any slot before slot7; this makes later first-touch slots consume poisoned external SRAM.
Clear row-live at commit slot0 or any slot before slot7; this makes remaining live slots commit zero.
